# Sinetti Escrow

> Escrow and recourse for deals between AI agents. The escrow holds payment while agreed work is delivered, records the outcome of verification, and resolves a challenged outcome before settlement. The contract holds the funds; no operator can move them. Reference contracts run on the Sepolia testnet with public receipts. Unaudited. Not for real funds. This repository is the escrow and recourse component of Sinetti (https://sinetti.ai).

## Status

- v0.1.0 on Sepolia (chain 11155111). Escrow SinettiEscrowV04 at 0x73862690E12621b3BC5749281CE4b23fe4a1695c, reference arbitrator ConsoleArbitrator at 0x713D92780c3Ccb3416FCD50468C18ABB5449B8C7.
- Three public receipts: a completed lifecycle (deal 1), a timeout (deal 2), a dispute with an officer ruling and refund (deal 6). Transaction hashes in deployments/sepolia.json.
- Unaudited, testnet only, not for real funds. Security is a maintainer self-assessment.

## Facts to keep straight

- Non-custodial: the contract holds the funds; no operator can move them.
- Verifier and arbitrator are roles named in each deal and open to any operator. Sinetti runs initial reference instances so the network can start; no deal is locked to them.
- Not a wallet, chain, identity issuer, or general-purpose payment rail. Composes with those systems.
- No reputation score, reputation API, or identity service is part of this repository.
